name: H3 Video Turbo
summary: A clip with its own sound from a prompt, on MiniMax H3 with taomate's 3-step turbo LoRA: a sixth of the steps of the plain app.

source.notes: Local turbo clone of h3-video (taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors at 3 steps, euler), rebuilt by local/make-turbo-apps.py; the upstream app is untouched.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: A street cook in Mexico City flips tacos on a hot griddle, steam and sizzling sound, he looks up and says: "Two more coming right up!"
inputs.help: Put spoken words in quotes; describe sounds and music too.

inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.help: Total pixels of the clip: ComfyUI's ResolutionSelector rounds each side to 32 (0.4 MP is 864x480 at 16:9, 0.8 MP is 1216x688). Attention grows with the square of the frame: 0.8 MP is already about three times the denoise time of 0.4 MP on this GPU. 1.0 MP and above run out of memory (measured).

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The turbo LoRA is trained for 3 steps; more steps cost time and usually add nothing. Fewer look rougher.

inputs.label: Sampler
inputs.help: euler is what the turbo LoRA was trained with; res_multistep is the plain app's sampler, smoother at equal steps but slower to settle at 3 or 4.

inputs.label: Sparse attention (H3 SLA)
inputs.help: The ROCm SLA node. Turn it off on CUDA/XPU, or on a backend that does not ship it: the node is bypassed and the model goes straight to the sampler. It is also bypassed automatically when the backend lacks the class.

test.prompt: a cat yawns on a sunny windowsill

notes: The same graph as H3 Video with taomate's 3-step LoRA (strength 1.0) on the diffusion model and the sampler set to euler at 3 steps. Use it for drafts and batches: the denoise phase runs 3 steps instead of 20, so a clip costs a fraction of the plain app's GPU time. Speech and sounds still come out of the model; the text encoder, VAEs and resolution are unchanged. Local turbo variant, not part of the video-h3 pack: freefield's catalogue has no Hub entry for taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors, so it is not downloaded with the pack. Keep the file in ComfyUI/models/loras.
